full_text:
The Tomb of Tutankhamun is the tomb of the renowned pharaoh Tutankhamun. The secret entrance of the tomb can be opened only with the Key of Nefertiti, a special key located in the Tomb of Nefertiti.

==Hystory==
Rassimov came to the tomb with Harrison Fears, planing to find the Necklace of Tutankhamun, an item that he believed could control the Nullifiers. He was, however, arrested by Dante Vale and his team, who entered the tomb themselves and found the Necklace by alining the statues. [Rassimov's Secret]

==Hystory==
